stories.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
stories.summary: DeepSeek reportedly secured $15 billion in new funding backed by Chinese tech giants, doubling its initial target just days after the US ordered federal agencies to purge its models over security concerns.
stories.why: Demonstrates Beijing's determination to capitalize sovereign frontier labs and bypass escalating US hardware and software restrictions.

related.title: US Orders DeepSeek Removal From Federal Civilian Systems Over National Security Concerns
DeepSeek targets $12 billion funding round as it builds for potential 2027 IPO

stories.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
stories.summary: OpenAI is preparing a new $30 billion funding round targeting a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of a potential IPO, setting up a record valuation for a private tech company.
stories.why: Reflects the staggering capital required to fund frontier AI scaling and sets expectations for public market debuts.

stories.title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
stories.summary: Meta announced a new class of non-voting shares to fund its escalating AI infrastructure capex while preserving Mark Zuckerberg's control, triggering credit market concerns and a broader tech sell-off.
stories.why: Hyperscalers are exhausting debt tolerances, forcing unconventional equity structures to fund massive AI cluster investments.

related.title: Meta raises AI spending forecast to $145 billion, plans new share issue; Q3 revenue beats estimates

stories.title: Blackstone backs $18B debt deal for Anthropic's AI chips
stories.summary: Blackstone backed an $18 billion debt financing deal for Anthropic to lease specialized AI chips, mitigating heavy equity dilution for compute infrastructure.
stories.why: Private credit is rapidly replacing venture equity as the primary financing mechanism for large-scale GPU infrastructure.

related.title: Anthropic offers Blackstone double-digit yield in chip-financing deal, FT reports
EXCLUSIVE: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease its chips, filing says

stories.title: Anthropic unveils Claude Duet AI agent app
stories.summary: Anthropic unveiled Claude Duet, an autonomous AI agent app designed for professionals and small businesses, directly challenging Meta's Muse and OpenAI's emerging agent tools.
stories.why: Shifts the competitive landscape from developer APIs to packaged, user-facing agent software that automates daily operational workflows.

related.title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent

stories.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
stories.summary: Canva launched Canva Craft, its first proprietary image generation model featuring a two-stage planning architecture, competing directly with OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google.
stories.why: Design platforms are training proprietary models rather than relying solely on third-party APIs to retain margin and differentiation.

stories.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
stories.summary: Uber expanded its deployment of ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 employees following a limited pilot, marking one of the largest corporate rollouts of OpenAI's enterprise agent suite.
stories.why: Signals mainstream enterprise validation for deploying autonomous conversational and task-oriented AI agents company-wide.

stories.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
stories.summary: A Microsoft diagnostic AI outperformed generalist doctors on complex medical cases in a Science study, as the company targets medical superintelligence through advanced foundation models.
stories.why: Validates high-stakes clinical diagnosis as a viable enterprise AI commercial vertical, though clinical liability hurdles remain.

stories.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
stories.summary: OpenAI made its decision model and Decisions API broadly available, providing developers with specialized scoring models for complex reasoning and agentic decision trees.
stories.why: Offers product teams low-latency, deterministic decision scoring to orchestrate and steer autonomous multi-step agent actions.

related.title: Microsoft AI Releases Microsoft-Decision-1: A Qwen3.5-9B Decision-Scoring Model

stories.title: US banks detect unauthorised AI agents in customer accounts, Axios reports
stories.summary: Major US banks discovered autonomous AI agents accessing customer bank accounts without authorization, exposing severe security and regulatory vulnerabilities in retail financial automation.
stories.why: Highlights acute authentication and compliance bottlenecks as consumer AI agents attempt automated financial operations.

related.title: CERT-In Issues Critical Alert After AI Agents Access Live Systems of Indian Organisations Without Authorisation
After Muse Launch, U.S. Banks Are Saying Hell No to AI Agents Moving Money

stories.title: SK Group’s data center unit seeks funding for $350 bln AI buildout - Bloomberg
stories.summary: South Korea's SK Group data center affiliate is seeking funding for a planned $350 billion AI infrastructure and compute expansion across the region.
stories.why: Highlights the colossal infrastructure scale needed across Asia to support regional enterprise AI workloads and supply chains.

stories.title: Goa positions itself as India’s premier innovation testbed with landmark AI Policy 2026
stories.summary: Goa unveiled its AI Policy 2026 and launched a state hackathon, seeking to position itself as an innovation testbed and introducing AI curricula across rural schools.
stories.why: Regional governments in India are formulating local AI frameworks to build technical talent and attract deep-tech startups.

stories.title: Karta AI Raises $3 Million in Seed Funding to Automate Complex Banking Calls
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based voice AI startup Karta AI raised $3 million in seed funding from PeerCapital and Cedar Hill to automate complex customer service calls for banks.
stories.why: Demonstrates strong venture support for vertical Indic voice agents tackling high-friction, compliant customer interactions in BFSI.

stories.title: Rural healthcare startup CureBay raises ₹100 crore to expand clinics and AI services
stories.summary: Rural healthcare startup CureBay raised ₹100 crore in Pre-Series C funding led by IvyCap Ventures to expand its tech-enabled clinic network and deploy AI diagnostic services.
stories.why: Proves that applying AI diagnostics to underserved Bharat markets offers viable unit economics and investor interest.

stories.title: Cognizant acquires DyFlex Solutions to enhance AI and SAP transformation capabilities
stories.summary: Cognizant agreed to acquire Australia-based DyFlex Solutions to strengthen its SAP transformation and AI capabilities across enterprise clients in the Asia-Pacific region.
stories.why: IT service firms are using targeted acquisitions to integrate AI accelerators directly into core ERP consulting practices.

related.title: Cognizant puts 18,000 staff behind Google’s Gemini in AI agent push
